title: Durable SCHC floors permanently exhaust TOFU peer capacity
description: _AuthenticatedReassemblyManager.replacement_occupied() counts durable admission floors, and LinkLayer._peer_has_eviction_blocker_unlocked() therefore refuses to evict any peer that has ever fragmented. Floors never expire, so after enough otherwise-idle peers, every pin is permanently protected and all new authenticated peers fail admission. Active contexts and response hold-downs must remain blockers, but floor-only state may be retired atomically during TOFU eviction because ReplayProtector retains a conservative permanent per-signer counter floor; add a bounded-capacity regression proving floor-only peers are safely evictable while active/tombstoned peers are not.
